reasons: cookie-tamper-probe is recommended because the current inventory contains web_target_present.
runners.summary: cookie-tamper-probe is recommended because the current inventory contains web_target_present.
runners.description: Detects identity-token forging via input-field delimiter injection. Some apps build session cookies by concatenating user-controlled strings with delimiters (pipe, colon, semicolon) without escaping. By registering a username like `foo|admin|author`, an attacker forges a cookie that decodes to an admin identity. This runner attempts delimiter injection during registration and verifies admin context — CRITICAL when successful.

reasons: file-upload-probe is recommended because the current inventory contains web_target_present.
runners.summary: file-upload-probe is recommended because the current inventory contains web_target_present.
runners.description: Detects file upload XSS and path-traversal exploits. Registers as author, uploads HTML payload with a unique marker, then verifies the server serves it back as text/html with payload reflected verbatim (stored XSS). Also tests filename-based path traversal (`../foo.html`) — if uploaded file lands outside the user's directory, the server is writing attacker-chosen paths. CRITICAL findings per success.
